# libs-gui tests that cannot pass under the headless backend.
#
# None of these is an Android problem.  Every entry was reproduced on Linux
# with the same headless backend, at the same libs-gui and libs-back commits,
# and fails there with the same counts.  The backend is the variable, not the
# platform.
#
# HeadlessFontEnumerator finds no font, so every text measurement is zero:
# -advancementForGlyph: gives {0, 0}, -ascender and -descender give 0, and
# -sizeWithAttributes: gives {0, 0}.  Anything that measures or lays out text
# therefore fails.  HeadlessGState implements 8 of the 26 primitives GSGState
# declares as subclassResponsibility, so the other 18 raise
# NSInvalidArgumentException when a drawing path reaches them.  libs-back #232
# implements those 18.
#
# A test listed here fails on any headless build.  A test NOT listed here that
# fails is a regression.

GSHorizontalTypesetter/longRun
GSHorizontalTypesetter/paragraphSpacing
NSApplication/applicationIconImage
NSAttributedString/headIndentDrawing
NSBox/rendering
NSBrowser/drop
